q1_issues.issue: The rule premise contains Skolem function terms - (Member (sk_lantern $a) lantern), (Possession (sk_lantern $a) $a) and (Patient $e (sk_lantern $a)) - which the instruction set forbids (a premise never contains a Skolem term; those belong to conclusions), so nothing can match the premise and the rule can never fire; the lantern should be a plain variable.

notes: Everything else is right: bare when-plus-indefinite routed to the rule form, Possession with possessed first, Patient on the intransitive fail and reset undergoers, the During tie, the solo_count genus with its non-predicable modifier suppressed, and that apprentice bound to the premise variable.
